image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of a small turtle walking on dry, cracked earth with scattered pine needles. The turtle has a dark, smooth, high-domed shell and distinct red/orange markings on the side of its neck and upper forelimb. The head is extended, showing a dark eye and pointed snout.
